lines.text: The LORD has Moses collect twelve staffs, one per tribe leader, with the name Aaron written on the staff of Levi.
Moses places the staffs in the Tent of Meeting, and the chosen man's staff will swallow the other staffs.
Moses lays twelve staffs before the LORD, and the next day the staff of Levi has buds, blossoms, and almonds.
Moses puts Aaron's staff back in front of the Testimony as a sign for the rebellious, lest they be scattered.
The Israelites cry that they are lost, that anyone near the tabernacle will die, and ask if all will perish.
